206:t_1:260.en:
$$レナード$$
「As you can see. This coat has that kind of function.」

206:t_1:261.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then with firepower this function can't stop...」

206:t_1:262.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's not all I've prepared on my end.」

206:t_1:265.en:
$$レナード$$
「Plan 1211, $$アラストル$$. The world's smallest Arm Slave, you might say.」

206:t_1:266.en:
$$宗介$$
「But if I eliminate you, its master, it's nothing but a hunk of junk...!」

206:t_1:267.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Stop, $$宗介$$! He's $$テッサ$$'s big brother!」

206:t_1:268.en:
$$宗介$$
「But he's our enemy! The Captain says so too!」

206:t_1:269.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'd like you to calm down a little. I came here to talk.」

206:t_1:270.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$千鳥かなめ$$... If you don't mind, could you ask your watchdog there to put up with this for a bit?」

206:t_1:271.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll show you right now whether I'm just a watchdog.」

206:t_1:273.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm not telling you to lower your gun. I just want you to listen.」

206:t_1:275.en:
$$レナード$$
「My business is simple. $$千鳥かなめ$$, will you give up your life as it is now and come with me?」

206:t_1:277.en:
$$レナード$$
「I promise you a reasonably free and wealthy life. There are facilities ready, enough to satisfy your intellectual curiosity, and above all, perfect freedom.」

206:t_1:278.en:
$$レナード$$
「And of course, we won't let the $$新地球皇国$$ interfere either.」

206:t_1:279.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't understand what you're saying. Are you making fun of me?」

206:t_1:280.en:
$$レナード$$
「All right. Then I'll explain in a little more detail.」

206:t_1:281.en:
$$レナード$$
「My organization has finally gotten serious.」

206:t_1:283.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ミスリル$$ and $c tried too hard. But that effort turned out to be the problem.」

206:t_1:284.en:
$$レナード$$
「Until now the organization didn't consider your existence important, but as the situation has changed, we've been forced to make some changes to our strategy.」

206:t_1:285.en:
$$レナード$$
「As part of that, partly to make an example, we've decided to reap the most irritating presence of all.」

206:t_1:287.en:
$$レナード$$
「It seems you understand. That submarine and the white AS with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$... would that be the ARX-7?」

206:t_1:288.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's no need for me to answer.」

206:t_1:289.en:
$$レナード$$
「...What a shame. It doesn't look like you and I will ever be friends.」

206:t_1:290.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you mean to keep spouting nonsense, this conversation is over.」

206:t_1:291.en:
$$レナード$$
「All right. Anyway, that's how it is. I'd have liked you to make an ideal exit, if possible...」

206:t_1:292.en:
$$レナード$$
「But we're past the stage where I can talk about exits and control.」

206:t_1:293.en:
$$レナード$$
「The conclusion that follows is simple. ...We crush the enemy. And we take '$$ヨブ$$'.」

206:t_1:295.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's her codename. Don't worry about it.」

206:t_1:296.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Does that mean you'll crush $$テッサ$$ and $$宗介$$ and abduct me?」

206:t_1:297.en:
$$レナード$$
「The organization has already decided to hold you, even if it takes rough methods.」

206:t_1:298.en:
$$レナード$$
「...That's enough, isn't it? The explanation of why I came all this way to pick you up.」

206:t_1:299.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So you came to persuade me beforehand...?」

206:t_1:300.en:
$$レナード$$
「Yes... Because I like you.」

206:t_1:306.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Fine. Thanks so much for being so kind.」

206:t_1:307.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But I have school, and I like my life the way it is.」

206:t_1:308.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And most of all, there's no way in hell I'm going anywhere with you!」

206:t_1:309.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I've told you over and over, I can't stand you! Now get out of this school right now!!」

206:t_1:310.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're so cold. Are you still angry about that... thing?」

206:t_1:311.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Didn't you hear me? Get lost!」

206:t_1:312.en:
$$宗介$$
(What is he talking about...? That thing...)

206:t_1:313.en:
$$レナード$$
「Why not just accept it already?」

206:t_1:315.en:
$$レナード$$
「You're a chosen human being, already beyond a genius. And yet people only think about using us with their glib talk.」

206:t_1:316.en:
$$レナード$$
「Is being ordered around by them what you want?」

206:t_1:318.en:
$$レナード$$
「You must have noticed by now. That the people around you are hopelessly dull and foolish.」

206:t_1:319.en:
$$レナード$$
「Deep down, aren't you irritated by how slow on the uptake they are?」

206:t_1:321.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I will. I've given my warning, after all.」

206:t_1:322.en:
$$レナード$$
「I hope you won't blame me for whatever happens from here on.」

206:t_1:323.en:
$$レナード$$
「Well then, until we meet again.」

206:t_1:327.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$! Take $$千鳥$$ and run, right now!」

206:t_2:3.en:
$$宗介$$
($$アマルガム$$ had already infiltrated the school...)

206:t_2:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(And they've taken $$常磐$$ hostage and are demanding $$千鳥$$ be handed over...)

206:t_2:6.en:
$$宗介$$
(But they say if $c sets foot in $$陣代高校$$, they'll blow up the school building along with the students still inside...)

206:t_2:7.en:
$$宗介$$
(What should I do...? Can I really do this with only what I have now...?)

206:t_2:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know it's a shock. But...」

ヨブ.evidence: Codename of Kaname per Leonard (t_1:295 'that's her codename' after he says Amalgam will take 'ヨブ'); ヨブ is the Japanese form of the Biblical name Job (ヨブ記 = Book of Job)

常磐.evidence: Sousuke's surname-only address for hostage Kyoko Tokiwa (glossary 常盤恭子 = Kyoko Tokiwa; the script writes 磐, the sheet 盤); Kaname says キョーコ in t_2:4 just before

kept_omissions: 206:t_1:313: いい加減に受け入れたら - object of 'accept' left open (his offer / what he said about her); kept as 'accept it'
